Fantastic view and great view from balcony
Jan 2020 • Couples
We had no plans to go to a restaurant on our first night in Ho Chi Minh but as we walked around the back of the Ben Tan Markets we noticed a huge amount of activity and realised they were setting up for the night market.
We made a bee line for the Spice Garden when we saw that its balcony overlooked the street where the market was being set up. We planned to have a beer and watch the street below - but when we saw the menu and very reasonable prices (4 beers, soft drink, water, two starters and a pot of fried rice for AUD $25) we decided to stay. We had a delicious meal, very well-paced so we could enjoy our drinks and keep an eye on the street below.
We highly recommend this restaurant for its quality Vietnamese food, good drink menu and excellent view. Such a great start to our stay in Ho Chi Minh!
